title: New Moon in Cancer
tldr: A seed point for protection, emotional honesty, home, belonging, and the private life that supports the public one.
theme: Cancer is a cardinal water sign ruled traditionally by Moon. This New Moon begins work around protection, emotional honesty, home, belonging, and the private life that supports the public one.
shadow: caretaking as avoidance of your own needs, or protecting yourself until connection cannot reach you
integration: creating safety that does not become isolation

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where protection became a wall instead of a home.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Cancer; watch what the Capricorn Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Luna kamea, silver or white candle, lavender, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Cancer. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through protection, emotional honesty, home, belonging, and the private life that supports the public one, without repeating the shadow of caretaking as avoidance of your own needs, or protecting yourself until connection cannot reach you?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Cancer intention take form?
